facility_roles.quote: The SIDDHARTA-2 experiment at the DAΦNE electron–positron collider performs high-precision X-ray spectroscopy of kaonic atoms

intervals.label: construction of the SIDDHARTA-2 apparatus
intervals.note: As of March 2018 the upgraded apparatus 'is being realized' and the paper expects it to be installed on DAΦNE starting with 2018. In January 2022 the full apparatus was 'presently under installation' (arXiv:2201.09735), so the interval runs to 2022 (year precision); it overlaps the 2021 SIDDHARTINO pilot run, which used a reduced set-up.
intervals.quote: SIDDHARTA-2, is being realized to reach this goal

intervals.label: DAΦNE data taking (SIDDHARTINO pilot run, then SIDDHARTA-2)
intervals.note: Year precision. DAΦNE delivered data first to the preliminary SIDDHARTINO set-up (kaonic helium) and later to the final SIDDHARTA-2 configuration. The October 2026 review (arXiv:2610.35399) and INFN's laboratories page describe the experiment as operating at DAΦNE.
intervals.quote: Since 2021, DAΦNE has been providing data to the SIDDHARTA experiment

intervals.label: SIDDHARTINO pilot run (kaonic helium)
intervals.note: Year precision; the final period of SIDDHARTINO data taking was in June 2021 (arXiv:2201.09735).
intervals.quote: a pilot run with a reduced setup, SIDDHARTINO, was performed in 2021 during the commissioning of the DAΦNE collider

intervals.label: kaonic deuterium campaign (2023-2024 data taking)
intervals.locator: Sirghi et al. (arXiv:2610.35399), Section on kaonic deuterium
intervals.note: Year precision. Deuterium operations 'started officially on the second half of May 2023' (arXiv:2409.17845) and a hydrogen-gas calibration run followed.
intervals.quote: The kaonic deuterium campaign was carried out with a cryogenic gaseous target during the 2023–2024 data-taking period.

intervals.label: kaonic hydrogen measurement runs
intervals.note: Two runs: December 2023 to February 2024 and April to May 2024.
intervals.quote: The measurement was performed in two separate runs, from December 2023 to February 2024 and from April to May 2024, for a total integrated luminosity of 237 pb−1

lineage.note: Scordo et al. (arXiv:1803.02587) call the SIDDHARTA-2 apparatus 'a new version of the experimental apparatus' built on the 2009 SIDDHARTA experience.
lineage.quote: it is planned to install a new enhanced version of the SIDDHARTA detector on the accelerator

website.note: The page describes SIDDHARTA-2 inside the KAONNIS initiative; its plans refer to 2020-2021 and it was not updated afterwards.

name: SIDDHARTA-2
notes: Kind hadron_structure is the nearest Atlas kind for kaonic-atom (low-energy QCD) physics at an e+e- collider.
KAONNIS is the wider INFN-LNF kaon-nucleus programme that includes SIDDHARTA-2, AMADEUS and J-PARC measurements; only SIDDHARTA-2 is recorded here.

SIDDHARTA-2 papers seen in the sources fetched cover kaonic helium-4 (arXiv:2310.20584), kaonic neon (arXiv:2412.16101) and kaonic hydrogen (arXiv:2607.13952); no kaonic deuterium result was found as of 2026-10-26.

physics_goals.quote: to perform the first-ever measurement of kaonic deuterium X-ray transitions to the fundamental level
physics_goals.value: First measurement of kaonic deuterium X-ray transitions to the 1s ground state, with high-precision spectroscopy of other light kaonic atoms

summary.plain: The successor to SIDDHARTA at Frascati's DAΦNE, built to measure for the first time the X-rays of kaonic deuterium and other kaonic atoms. After a 2021 pilot run (SIDDHARTINO) it took kaonic helium, neon, hydrogen and deuterium data; a 2026 paper reports the most precise kaonic hydrogen values.
summary.technical: SIDDHARTA-2: cryogenic gaseous target (deuterium, hydrogen, helium) surrounded by silicon drift X-ray detectors with kaon-trigger scintillators, veto counters and lead shielding at DAΦNE; SIDDHARTINO pilot run 2021, deuterium campaign 2023-2024; kaonic hydrogen 1s shift ε = −303.0 ± 17.0 ± 2.5 eV and width Γ = 607 ± 62 ± 6 eV from 237 pb⁻¹ (arXiv:2607.13952).
